Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.query

Class QueryConditionDsl

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.query.QueryConditionDsl
  • public class QueryConditionDsl
extends Object
    Domain specific language to create the Querys conditions in fluent API style. It closely resembles the constraintStart from the JCR-SQL2 language, except that we use casts as needed but we don't expose this construct explicitly. This immediately creates the needed JCR SQL2-representation.

    The general rule is that a complete SQL2 word gets a space appended.

    Author:
    Hans-Peter Stoerr
    See Also:
    "http://www.h2database.com/jcr/grammar.html#condition", "https://docs.adobe.com/docs/en/spec/jcr/2.0/6_Query.html"

      • builder

      • fromString

        public static QueryConditionDsl.QueryCondition fromString​(String sql2)
        Creates a QueryCondition with the given sql2 as condition. This is only provided for special cases, where using the builder is not possible, such as queries saved in configurations.

        Caution: The query must be a SQL2 Constraint that applies only to the selector "n", for example: 

        
     CONTAINS(n.[*] , 'foo' ) AND ISCHILDNODE(n,'/somewhere' ) AND LOWER( LOCALNAME(n) ) = 'bar'
     OR n.[jcr:created] > CAST('2008-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' AS DATE)
        (There will be other, Query implementation dependent, selectors in place.)

        To provide transparent access to both resources in a checked in release as unversioned or current resources, accesses to the properties that are changed in frozen nodes will be replaced when accessing the history: n.[jcr:primaryType] will be replaced by n.[jcr:frozenPrimaryType] and n.[jcr:uuid] will be replaced by n.[jcr:frozenUuid].
